notes: The opening journal. One entry per page.
scene: what is shown behind the page: flight, landing, night or dark.
lines: shown one at a time. An empty line is a pause.
A line may be written as { "text": ..., "cue": "cavein" } to set off the cave-in when it appears.

lines: The aeroplane left Cairo at first light.
For three hours there was nothing below us but sand, and the shadow of our own wings.
Then the pyramids, small as a child's bricks, and the river like a green thread beside them.
I have waited eleven years to see this country.
I did not expect it to be so quiet.
We came down beside a village the maps do not name.
The guides were waiting with the camels, as the foreman had promised.
Two days south of here, in a dry valley, his men have uncovered a stair cut into the rock.
Sixteen steps. A sealed door. No name on it.
Tomorrow we ride out.
The door is open.
The air that came out was cold, and smelled of dust and something sweet.
A passage. One chamber. Plain walls. No gold. The men are disappointed. I am not.
There is a draught in the chamber. In a sealed tomb there should be no draught.
It comes from the back wall.
I went in alone before breakfast, to measure the back wall.
I heard the men shouting first.
Then the timber props.

lines.text: The roof of the passage came down behind me.

lines: I remember the noise.
I do not remember falling.
